profile.headline: CTO / VP / Head of Engineering | Architect | Platform & Data Engineering | AI-Enabled Development
profile.summary:
I've spent my career building and leading engineering organizations, and I've stayed close to the building itself throughout. I've founded engineering functions, modernized SaaS and data platforms, and put the operating discipline in place that lets teams deliver predictably, while never handing off the architectural decisions.
 
Much of my recent focus has been on data platforms, because you have no AI strategy without a data strategy. Strong, well-governed data foundations are what make meaningful analytics and AI possible, and I've repeatedly turned fragmented systems into platforms teams can actually trust.
 
I've worked across B2B and B2B2C SaaS, eCommerce, retail media, recommerce, and risk quantification. What ties it together is a focus on platform health, pragmatic architecture, and keeping engineering a genuine partner to the business. I'm known for building strong engineering leaders and for taking ideas from zero to one without losing reliability or culture along the way.
 
Right now I'm building a full-stack, enterprise-grade product end to end, with OCR and retrieval-augmented generation built into it. I'm writing the code myself, using AI-assisted development, with direct ownership of architecture, implementation, and deployment.
 
I care about clarity, and simplicity over unnecessary complexity. I lead through technical credibility, kindness, and integrity, and I believe great engineering organizations are built through trust and feedback, not heroics. I'm a voracious reader, and I keep up with both technology and leadership practice.
 
Core areas: Engineering Leadership | Platform Engineering | Data Engineering | Data Platforms | Data Infrastructure | Distributed Systems | Event-Driven Architecture | Real-Time Processing | Stream Processing | Data Serving & Query Systems | Multi-Tenant SaaS | SaaS Architecture | Platform Extensibility | Internal Developer Platforms | Developer Experience | Production Infrastructure | Observability | High Availability | Warehouse Modernization | ML Systems | Retrieval-Augmented Generation | AI-Assisted Engineering Workflows | Security & Compliance

positions.title: Architect & Software Engineer
positions.description: Building a full-stack, enterprise-grade product end to end, with software architecture as the focus. OCR and retrieval-augmented generation are built into the product, and I'm writing the code myself using AI-assisted development, with direct ownership of architecture, implementation, and deployment. Production-ready architecture with full environment separation managed as infrastructure as code, and CI/CD with per-branch testing, full unit and end-to-end coverage, and AI agents reviewing every pull request. I lead a small team of collaborators across product, frontend engineering, and QA.
positions.insights: Skills: Cloudinary · Terraform · Anthropic Claude · Snowflake · Cloudflare · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) · PostgreSQL · Large Language Models (LLM) · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: SVP, Engineering
positions.description: Led a distributed engineering organization spanning application engineering, data, DevOps, enterprise tooling, QA automation, and technical program management. Re-architected the data platform into a governed medallion architecture with a semantic layer, cutting pipeline failures from roughly 20% to 2%. Restructured the data engineering team to roughly half its size as that work removed the toil that had consumed it, redeploying senior engineers onto higher-impact work. Introduced role specialization and planning and delivery discipline that improved predictability and reliability. Stood up a dedicated enterprise tooling and automation function, and grew the overall organization from 26 to 56 in five months.

positions.title: SVP, Technology
positions.description: Led software engineering, data engineering, machine learning, DevOps, IT, and security for a retail media recommendation platform drawing on profiles of 90 million online shoppers. Founded the data engineering function and owned the recommendation-serving infrastructure. Re-architected real-time event ingestion when the previous collection model became too expensive to scale. Designed a consistent model-serving interface that decoupled the recommendation API from individual models, enabling A/B testing and faster model iteration. Remodeled the data pipelines to prepare for feature-store development.

positions.title: CTO | Head of Engineering
positions.description: Founding technical leader and the third engineer. Built the platform, organization, and culture from inception. Architected a multi-tenant recommerce SaaS platform on reusable components, spanning storefronts, warehouse operations, buy- and sell-side pricing, and reverse logistics for premium brands including Patagonia, lululemon, and REI, sustaining 99.99% uptime over five years. Pioneered single-SKU recommerce logistics and delivered rapid zero-to-one builds, including a 12-app build in 12 weeks (spanning curation through point of sale) for a Nordstrom flagship store resale pop-up launch in NYC.

positions.title: VP of Engineering | Director of Engineering
positions.description: Led engineering for the website, APIs, mobile application, and a PCI-scoped infrastructure environment. Drove a non-compliant inherited environment to PCI DSS Level 1, piloted PCI-compliant cloud infrastructure with a major cloud provider ahead of its general availability, and built APIs powering offers on partner sites including MSN Money, myFICO, and Experian.

positions.title: VP of Software Engineering | VP of Software Architecture
positions.description: Led software engineering and architecture for a global platform serving 1,400 institutions and 80 million registered users across 54 countries and 27 languages, progressing from Software Engineering Director to VP of Software Architecture to VP of Software Engineering. Led a full re-architecture from a proprietary object store to PostgreSQL, migrating 450+ tables at 100% uptime using dual writes and a data checker, and replacing a brittle transactional system with a reliable, modern data foundation. Introduced a layered REST API that opened the platform to customers' own developers.
